metadata.name: Rangpo-Singtam Critical Infrastructure
metadata.source: Sikkim PWD / SSDMA / Survey of India

properties.name: Rangpo Teesta Highway Bridge
properties.description: Primary interstate gateway bridge connecting West Bengal to Sikkim across Teesta River.

properties.name: Singtam Suspension Bridge & Junction
properties.description: Critical river crossing connecting Singtam Bazar with South and East Sikkim corridors.

properties.name: Singtam District Hospital
properties.description: Sub-divisional apex trauma and healthcare facility for NH-10 corridor.

properties.name: Rangpo Primary Health Centre (PHC)
properties.description: First response medical station at Sikkim border.

properties.name: Majhitar Culvert Weep-Drain Drainage #4
properties.description: High-capacity storm culvert discharging colluvial runoff from Majhitar ridge.

properties.name: Bardang Highway Reinforced Retaining Wall
properties.description: Gabion and RCC anchored retaining wall protecting toe from Teesta river scouring.

properties.name: Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology (SMIT) Campus
properties.description: Major institutional campus in Majhitar with residential hostels.

properties.name: Rangpo Police Outpost & SDRF Sub-Station
properties.description: Disaster emergency unit and first responder mobilization center.

properties.name: Singtam Power Substation (66kV)
properties.description: Major electrical power distribution node for Singtam and upper highway grid.

properties.name: Rangpo BSNL Telecom Tower & Fiber Hub
properties.description: Primary optical fiber and emergency wireless communication repeater.
